plugins.description: Cart contents and totals in a Cart tab.

handlers.name: http.mocks
handlers.description: The mock rules for HTTP calls made through devpul_http and devpul_dio, first match wins.

handlers.name: http.mocks.set
handlers.description: Replaces the mock rules and returns them. Args: rules, a list of {url (whole URL, * for any run of characters), method (null for any), on, mode (respond, fail, delay, pause), delayMs; respond: status, headers, body (text); fail: message; pause: request, response (booleans)}. Rules last until the app restarts.

handlers.name: http.paused
handlers.description: HTTP calls held at a pause rule, request or response.

handlers.name: http.resume
handlers.description: Lets a paused call go on. Args: id, and to change it: method, url, headers (all of them), body (text) at the request; status, statusMessage, headers, body at the response; abort: true fails it as a network error.
